generator.sourceMuxRule: source.mp4 is the single upload fixture and always contains the measured 48kHz stereo audio track (or exact silence). video-only intermediates are not upload inputs and are hash-locked only to reproduce source.mp4.

truth.oracle: owner IDs unchanged for every visible frame; no drawbox expression uses frame variable n

truth.overFrames: 60..99: opaque bar is drawn after subject
truth.oracle: behind/ambiguous/over phases are visually and oracle-distinguishable

truth.camera: static drawgrid/landmark background; crop window x=120+1.5f,y=120-0.5f, rotation=0.1f deg, scale=1+0.001f
truth.affineSignConvention: positive crop x moves observed background left; verifier records both crop-window delta and observed-image homography sign
truth.oracle: background homography comes only from static source crop/rotate/scale; no temporal source animation, foreground object, or drawbox frame expression participates
four exact single-frame visual peaks and audio clicks; no ease-out is asserted by this fixture
outer and inner bloom bands are visible outside owner alpha, Gaussian defocus calibration patch is separate, and rim/lower-light channels are numerically separable

truth.expectedFailure: static text box offset +8px and audio anchors +2400 samples must reject; no drawbox expression uses frame variable n

variants.removeText: identity text and text box absent
variants.removeCamera: static camera source with no crop/rotate/scale transform
variants.removeBloom: vfx bloom bands absent while owner/rim/defocus/lower-light remain
variants.removeDefocus: defocus calibration patch is sharp while sigma=6 is claimed

truth.expectedFailure: each executable variant is generated and hash-locked separately and fails only its corresponding text/camera/bloom/defocus claim

fixtureLock.owner: Todo 1 authority bootstrap creates the first lock before product source by expanding this contract with pinned FFmpeg/ImageMagick/fonts/x264 and running every fixture twice.
fixtureLock.todo4Policy: Todo 4 is verification-only for this lock: it implements a generator that must reproduce the locked rawFrameSha256, audioPcmSha256, videoOnlySha256, sourceMp4Sha256, normalizedWorkingSha256, ffprobe JSON digest and truth digest exactly; it may not rewrite fixture-manifest.lock.json or any authority-root child extension.
fixtureLock.variantPolicy: If a fixture defines variantFiltergraphs, Todo 1 fixture lock must include variantFiltergraphSha256, variantRawFrameSha256, variantVideoOnlySha256, variantSourceMp4Sha256, variantNormalizedWorkingSha256, variantFfprobeSha256 and variantTruthSha256 per variant name; Todo 4 verifies every variant byte-for-byte and cannot collapse prose variants into one output.
